title: AITA for being mad at a neighbour who was blowing snow at 5 AM?
question: AITA for being mad at a neighbour who was blowing snow at 5 AM?
body: I have an elderly neighbour who snow blows sidewalks and many of his neighbours driveways. It is wonderful! That being said, he was out at 5 am today. He’s typically out at 6 am. I am a deep sleeper so this wasn’t an issue for me. My fiancé was not so appreciative. He wants to know if he’s an asshole for being upset at the neighbour for doing a kind act at an ungodly hour.
